name: Ishiwatari Akihiro
source: A Neurosurgeon at the general hospital. A honor type who doesn't show his emotion very much. Likes children and wishes to be a lifelong doctor but is having problem with his parents regarding marriage.
translation: 综合医院的神经外科医生。他属于不太表露情绪的荣誉型人物。喜欢孩子，希望一生都当医生，却因为婚姻问题与父母产生了矛盾。
